remediation.summary: Repair the unintended application-owned rendering change and rerun the audit. If the change is intentional, review it and explicitly replace the baseline with visual-approve --replace-baseline.
technicalHints: Do not raise the threshold or overwrite the baseline solely to clear the gate.

items.title: Current rendering differs from the approved visual baseline

remediation.summary: 修复非预期且由应用造成的渲染变化后重新核查；若变化确属预期，应先人工复核，再通过 visual-approve --replace-baseline 显式替换基线。
technicalHints: 不要只为通过门禁而提高阈值或覆盖基线。

zh-CN.title: 当前渲染结果与已批准视觉基线不一致
